description: This file defines the TwoFactorAuth class managing two-factor authentication state, including activation, deactivation, and status fetching, using external providers and MobX for state management.

classes.name: TwoFactorAuth
classes.description: Class managing two-factor authentication state and operations.

methods.name: startActivation
methods.description: Initiates the process to activate two-factor authentication by generating a secret and updating status.

methods.name: fetchStatus
methods.description: Fetches current two-factor authentication status from provider.

methods.name: toggle2FA
methods.description: Toggles two-factor authentication on or off based on current status.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if user is logged in.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Getter for current two-factor authentication status.
